dek: Yankees closer David Bednar has until Tuesday, 4 p.m. ET, to accept or reject $23.15M.

slides.label: The Offer
slides.text: Yankees put a *one-year, $23.15 million* qualifying offer on closer David Bednar's table for 2027.

slides.label: The Deadline
slides.text: He has until *Tuesday, Nov. 17 at 4 p.m. ET* to accept or decline. No decision as of Sunday.

slides.label: The Odds
slides.text: The Post reports a decline *"appears more likely than not,"* which would send him to free agency.

slides.label: His Season
slides.text: Bednar went *7-3 with 35 saves* and a 2.47 ERA in 64 appearances, tying for third in the AL.

slides.label: Draft Pick Math
slides.text: If he leaves, the Yankees get a *compensation pick* after the fourth round of the 2027 Draft.

slides.label: Cashman's Stance
slides.text: GM Brian Cashman calls the bullpen *"probably our biggest need"* and says he's not afraid to spend big.

slides.label: Yes or No
slides.text: Yes, and he's back at the *highest average salary ever for a reliever*. No, and the Yankees scramble for a closer.

slides.label: The Bottom Line
slides.text: By 4 p.m. Tuesday, Bednar either *locks in $23.15M* in the Bronx or bets on himself in free agency.

caption_linkedin:
David Bednar's qualifying offer is a lesson in risk and timing. The Yankees put one year and $23.15 million on the table, the highest average salary ever offered a reliever on a single-year deal, and gave him until Tuesday at 4 p.m. ET to decide.

Take it, and he locks in security at the top of his market. Decline it, and he bets on himself in free agency, knowing a 7-3 season with 35 saves and a 2.47 ERA gives him a stronger case, even as a draft pick penalty follows him to his next team.

GM Brian Cashman called the bullpen "probably our biggest need," proof that even a $23.15 million offer does not remove uncertainty, it just sets a floor.

Every founder knows this tension: take the guaranteed number now, or bet on your own value later, knowing the market, and the fine print, shape the outcome either way.
